placeholders.why: The theme's stylesheet and token block: the first thing a re-skin overrides, and the file every customer sheet loads after.
The theme's JavaScript entry point. Ships empty and registered, so adding behaviour is an edit and never a create plus a wiring hunt.
The raw head-injection point. The Swift master's CustomHeadInclude field HTML-encodes, so JSON-LD and meta can only be emitted from here.
The only place a theme can set srcset, fetchpriority and image quality on the page's largest paint. Inert until a paragraph's Template field names it.
Responsive srcset, lazy loading and reserved geometry for a content image. Inert until a paragraph's Template field names it.
Overrides the component's hard-coded preload=auto so a page carrying video does not download it on load. Inert until a paragraph's Template field names it.
The wordmark slot, neutral grey. A re-skin overwrites this file in place instead of adding an asset and repointing every field that should have named it.
The wave motif as a readable single-path source. The CSS utility carries the same path inline as a mask data-URI; this file is what you edit when the curve changes.
